<entry id="A03444">
<head-word>אָתַר, </head-word>
<head-word>אֲתַר, </head-word>
<head-word>אַתְרָא</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> c. (= אתאר, denom. of אֲתָא, corresp. to h. מָקֹום, fr. קוּם) 
<italic>place, town</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Gen. XXII, 3; a. fr.—Ber. 63
<sup>a</sup>. Gen. R. s. 39 (prov.) מבית לבית וכ' removal from house to house (costs) a shirt;—from town to town, a life. Ex. R. s. 45, end אַתְרִי טפלה לי וכ' my (the Lord’s) place is an accidental attribute to me, but I am not accidental to my place; cmp. מָקֹום.—Ned. 49
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. מר כי אַתְרֵיה וכ' the one follows the custom of his place and the other that of his. B. Bath. 124
<sup>b</sup> לאתרין to 
<italic>our</italic> place.—
<plural-form>Pl. אַתְרִין, אַתְרַיָּא</plural-form>. Targ. Jud. XIX, 13; a. fr.—Y. Ber. II, 4
<sup>c</sup> מן א' סגין from many places (passages, authorities); Pesik. R. s. 22 היגיס אחריו (corr. acc.)—Denom. אַתְרוּתָא 
<italic>local custom</italic>. 
<plural-form>Pl. אֲתַרְוָותָא</plural-form>. Gitt. 89
<sup>a</sup> א' 
<pgbrk id="pg134"/>נינהו the customs of the places are divided.—בַּאֲתַר, בְּאַתְרֵי 
<italic>in place of, instead; in consequence of, because of, for</italic> (corresp to h. תַּחַת). Targ. II Chr. VI, 10; a. fr.—Targ. Job VIII, 4; a. fr.—V. בָּתַר.—על אתר (contr. אַלְתַּר q. v.) 
<italic>on the spot, presently</italic>. Y. Ber. I, 3
<sup>c</sup>. Ib. II, 4
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (comp. of בְּ, דִּי, a. לְ = h. בְּשֶׁל) 
<italic>as to what refers to</italic>—whence; 
<italic>on account of, for the sake of, in order that</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. O. Gen. VI, 3; a. e.—Lev. R. s. 28, end אזל ב' בלנאי he went for (the sake of getting) a bather. Y. Kidd. III, 64
<sup>a</sup> ב' דלא יכפור וכ' in order that he may not deny his owing a cup. Yoma 75
<sup>b</sup> ב' רבא וכ' (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) through the merit of the teacher is the scholar supported.—בְּדִילִי, בְּדִילָךְ &c. on my, thy account &c. Targ. O. Deut. III, 26; a. e. (Y. בגלל; b. h. למען).</notes></sense></senses></entry>
